### Laguna XS 2.1
Source: https://docs.poolside.ai/release-notes/models
Laguna XS 2.1 is a 33B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model featuring 3B activated parameters per token. It is optimized for local execution on hardware like Macs with 36 GB of RAM and supports a 256K token context window. Key enhancements include native reasoning support with interleaved thinking, improved multilingual coding performance, and optimized memory usage through FP8 KV cache quantization.

### Laguna S 2.1
Source: https://docs.poolside.ai/release-notes/models and /release-notes/overview
118B parameter MoE, 8B activated per token; designed for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks; 1M token context window; native reasoning with thinking modes; released under the OpenMDW-1.1 license; quantizations BF16, FP8, INT4, NVFP4, GGUF, MLX.

### Laguna M.1
Source: https://docs.poolside.ai/release-notes/overview
Optimized for multi-step agentic coding workflows that involve tool use and validation; 256K context window; improved benchmark results.
